dsh-code-review.meta.description: Read-only Git/SVN code review with approved snapshot context.
dsh-code-review.meta.title: Code Review

settings.autoReview.advancedHint: Limits evidence, output, retries, and failure recovery. Default values are recommended.
settings.autoReview.badgeCompatibility: Compatibility: official Harness has no per-tool badge or settings-navigation icon slots. Settings and review work; the command reviewing/denied glyph and settings-tab SVG require the accompanying tool.call.badges and settings.section.icon patches. Without them, native display is retained.
settings.autoReview.behaviorDefault: Read-only / Workspace write: normal sandboxed actions pass through; out-of-bounds, sensitive, and network actions are routed to review.
settings.autoReview.behaviorDisabled: Auto Review is off: every permission tier uses the native Harness approval chain only.
settings.autoReview.behaviorStrict: Read-only / Workspace write: sandboxed actions are also verified by the reviewer while preserving sandbox boundaries.
settings.autoReview.breakerCooldownMsHint: Time to wait before probing the reviewer again after a circuit breaker trip.
settings.autoReview.denied: Auto Review denied this tool call
settings.autoReview.enabledHint: When disabled, routing, approval, and refusal are left entirely to the native Harness chain.
settings.autoReview.escalateUncertain: Escalate uncertain or high-risk findings to strong reviewer
settings.autoReview.escalateUncertainHint: Escalation shares the retry timeout and never bypasses denies, sandbox, or manual approval.
settings.autoReview.failed: Failed to save settings. Check parameters or connection.
settings.autoReview.failureThresholdHint: Consecutive reviewer failures before tripping the circuit breaker.
settings.autoReview.flashHint: Low latency on the critical action path.
settings.autoReview.invalidSettings: Invalid reviewer configuration — check selected models
settings.autoReview.maxAttemptsHint: Starts a new reviewer session only after a call or protocol failure; up to 3.
settings.autoReview.maxInputBytesHint: Maximum size of sanitized action evidence passed to the reviewer.
settings.autoReview.modelStrategyHint: Single model always uses the primary reviewer. Tiered routes high-risk actions to the strong reviewer.
settings.autoReview.primaryProfileHint: Handles standard reviews. Provider route and model must exist in Harness configuration; credentials never reach the browser.
settings.autoReview.proHint: Higher review quality with increased latency and cost.
settings.autoReview.reasoningEffortHint: Optional provider parameter. Empty is most compatible.
settings.autoReview.reviewFullAccessHint: Enabled by default. Without sandbox, all actions except explicit denies are reviewed.
settings.autoReview.reviewing: Auto Review is checking this tool call
settings.autoReview.sandboxDefaultAllowHint: Applies only to read-only and workspace write modes.
settings.autoReview.saved: Settings saved and applied in real time.
settings.autoReview.strongKinds: Action kinds routed directly to the strong reviewer
settings.autoReview.strongKindsHint: Selected action types skip the primary reviewer and go directly to the strong reviewer.
settings.autoReview.strongProfileHint: Used only for configured high-risk types or escalation of uncertain results.
settings.autoReview.subtitle: Route actions to an isolated reviewer based on permission mode, sandbox boundaries, and policies.
settings.autoReview.timeoutMsHint: Maximum review time for a single action, including retries and risk escalation.
settings.autoReview.title: Auto Review
settings.autoReview.transcriptMaxBytesHint: Total byte limit for evidence history; does not expand the agent's main context.
settings.autoReview.transcriptMaxEntriesHint: Maximum number of sanitized history entries relevant to the current action.
